question: What event at the time of bodily death marks the culminating moment described?
premises: The time of body-fall is specified.
The skull is said to be split at that time.
The goddess is addressed as witness to this teaching.
inference: At the moment of death, the splitting of the skull occurs.
uncertainties: The doctrinal meaning of the skull splitting is not explicit in this verse alone.
plain_english: O goddess, when the body falls and the skull is split, then that occurs.
